【影像规格】
10秒，16:9，横屏全屏。

总制作费10亿日元规模的剧场版黑暗奇幻动画。
无音乐，仅有效果音。
无字幕、无文字、无Logo。

高品质日本黑暗奇幻动画。以2D赛璐璐动画为基础，仅魔法特效、发光、粒子、幽体表现使用高密度数字合成。

以黑暗空间为基础，采用以蓝、苍、青、青白、群青、紫、黑为中心的限定配色。

强烈发光、硬阴影、蓝色与紫色的轮廓光、空气中漂浮的细微魔力粒子、薄雾、空气透视。

【角色】

忠实再现生成时附带的参考图像中的女性角色。

在所有镜头中一致保持脸、发型、发色、服装、体格、年龄感。

女性表情冷静克制，但眼中有着直面敌人的明确意志与紧张感。

她始终注视着前方存在的敌人。

即使在控制魔法期间，也不只是盯着魔法阵，而是将视线投向其前方的敌人。

所有镜头中左右手指均为正常的5根手指。不破坏手指、手臂、脸、人体结构。

【敌人的呈现方式】

她们面对的強大敌人存在于画面右深处方向或前进方向的前方。

不明确拍摄敌人的全身或真身。

通过她的视线、从敌人方向吹来的强风、地面的微震动、空气的扭曲、雾与粒子被推回的现象、低沉的冲击波、从黑暗深处射入的不祥逆光，来表现巨大敌人的存在。

女性与两只幻兽都注视着同一方向的敌人。

不是召唤后就地待机，而是明确描绘女性与两只幻兽共同试图迎向敌人的流程。

【魔法阵的重要指定】

使用的魔法表现仅为圆形魔法阵。

魔法阵数量必须为两个。不得增加到三个以上。

两个魔法阵在所有镜头中必须始终位于女性前方。

不得出现在头顶、正后方或包围女性的位置。

女性前方左侧配置蓝色魔法阵，前方右侧配置紫色魔法阵。

各自作为独立的召唤术式启动。

魔法阵为半透明的圆环状或薄圆盘状。

由古代文字、几何图案、多个同心圆、纹章、旋转的圆环构成。

不是机械UI，而是如古代召唤仪式般神秘庄严的印象。

蓝色魔法阵发出蓝、青、青白的光。

紫色魔法阵发出紫、蓝紫、淡紫的光。

【召唤演出的重要指定】

幻兽不得从一开始就以完整的全身突然出现。

从两个魔法阵中，首先仅让幻兽的手、前脚、足、爪等身体的一部分以幽体化状态出现。

幽体化的部位为半透明，内部流动着蓝色或紫色的光。

不得从魔法阵中猛烈冲出。

如同巨大存在从水面下浮起一般，安静、沉重、诡异、缓缓地向前方浮现。

即使在短镜头中，也不是快速突进，而是看起来像截取了缓慢动作的一瞬。

幽体化部位出现的动作连续到下一个实体化镜头，跨镜头平滑地连接到全身实体化。

从蓝色魔法阵召唤一只蓝色系幻兽。

从紫色魔法阵召唤一只紫色系幻兽。

幻兽必须仅为两只。

两只被召唤于女性前方左右。

召唤后立即，两只幻兽站在女性前方。

随后，女性从两只幻兽之间堂堂正正地走出向前，站在三者最前方。

女性不是被保护而躲在后面，而是作为亲自迎向敌人的指挥者来描绘。

【幻兽设计】

幻兽仅为两只。彼此具有明确不同的轮廓。

第一只，是从蓝色魔法阵召唤的蓝色系巨大幻兽。

以蓝黑、群青、青色为基础色，融合狮子与龙的重量级幻兽。

拥有锐利的獠牙、粗壮的角、长鬃毛、巨大前脚、发蓝光的眼。

有重量感的四足步行型。每次踏地都扬起粉尘。

第二只，是从紫色魔法阵召唤的紫色系巨大幻兽。

以黑紫、蓝紫、淡紫为基础色，融合鸟兽与爬虫类的幻兽。

拥有长颈、锐利的下颚或喙、翼或背部的大突起、发紫光的眼。

轮廓比蓝色幻兽更细长锐利，使两只在视觉上可区分。

两只都比女性压倒性地巨大。

不得像摆件一样静止，要微妙地活动呼吸、鬃毛、翼端、尾巴、耳、爪、发光的眼。

两只都在女性支配之下，朝向共同敌人摆出临战态势。

【演出方针】

在10秒内使用较多镜头。

不得连续使用相同角度。

切换眼部特写、指尖极端近景、斜侧、仰拍、越过魔法阵的主观风、贴地低角度、斜后方、接近横向的斜广角。

前半段为注视敌人的紧张感与魔法操作的精密性。

中段为幽体化的一部分浮现的诡异感，以及巨大幻兽实体化的震撼力。

后半段展现女性从两只之间走出向前的主动性，以及三者迎向敌人的共斗感。

头发、服装、光、粒子、雾、魔法阵、幻兽的呼吸等，在所有镜头中保持某种运动。

【0.0～10.0秒的镜头构成】

■镜头1【0.0～0.5秒】

捕捉女性眼部的极端特写。

女性锐利地注视画面右深处方向的敌人。

瞳中映出蓝与紫的反射光。

从敌人方向吹来的强风使刘海摇动，空气微微震颤。

带有紧张感的短促导入。

■镜头2【0.5～1.0秒】

捕捉女性手部的极端特写。

蓝与紫的光分别聚集于手部。

女性前方空中，小的蓝色圆环与紫色圆环开始产生。

圆形纹样从手部如波纹般扩大。

背景以浅景深暗化模糊。

■镜头3【1.0～1.6秒】

斜侧中近景。

女性前方左侧形成蓝色魔法阵，前方右侧形成紫色魔法阵。

两个魔法阵位于她前方，越过魔法阵可见敌人方向的黑暗。

女性不只是看着魔法阵，而是注视其前方的敌人。

头发与服装因敌人方向的逆风大幅飘动。

■镜头4【1.6～2.2秒】

从低位置仰视女性的仰拍中景。

女性操作双手，前方左右的魔法阵旋转速度加快。

蓝色魔法阵与紫色魔法阵各自独立脉动。

古代文字、同心圆、纹章强烈发光。

■镜头5【2.2～2.8秒】

越过魔法阵的主观风镜头。

画面近前为巨大圆形纹样与旋转的古代文字。

短暂交替展示她前方的蓝色魔法阵与紫色魔法阵。

女性一边动手，视线一边固定于魔法阵前方的敌人。

■镜头6【2.8～3.0秒】

召唤途中的幽体化镜头。

从蓝色魔法阵中，蓝色系幻兽的巨大前脚与钩爪尖端作为半透明灵体，开始缓慢浮现。

从紫色魔法阵中，紫色系幻兽的巨大手、足或锐利爪子作为半透明灵体，静静地探出。

不得猛烈冲出。

在短时长中，仅截取缓慢出现动作的一瞬。

灵体内部有蓝色或紫色的光缓慢流动。

此动作连续到下一个镜头。

■镜头7【3.0～3.7秒】

从地面附近仰视的超低角度。

从她前方的魔法阵中浮现的幽体前脚与爪子，就这样缓慢向前探出并实体化。

从半透明灵体变化为拥有毛、鳞、角、爪的厚重实体。

接着头部、躯干、翼、尾巴通过魔法阵，两只巨大幻兽完全现身。

蓝色幻兽有青白色发光。

紫色幻兽有紫色发光。

实体化完成的同时光量急剧升高。

■镜头8【3.7～4.3秒】

贴地超低角度。

蓝色幻兽与紫色幻兽的巨大前脚以时间差着地。

着地冲击使地面震动，粉尘与小石弹起。

蓝色冲击波与紫色冲击波分别沿地面奔走。

两只在着地后立即将头部转向敌人方向。

■镜头9【4.3～5.0秒】

使用高速甩镜的片段式特写。

蓝色幻兽的獠牙、角、鬃毛、发蓝光的眼。

紫色幻兽的锐利下颚、翼端、背部突起、发紫光的眼。

不一次性说明性地展示两只全身，而是连续短片段以留下巨大与凶猛的印象。

两只瞪视共同敌人，压低身体。

■镜头10【5.0～6.0秒】

斜后方广角镜头。

画面前方左右并排两只巨大幻兽，女性站在两只后方中央。

蓝色幻兽与紫色幻兽之间，有可供女性一人通过的宽阔空间。

两只朝前方敌人采取前倾姿势，如打开中央进路般分列左右。
魔法阵已消失。

■镜头11【6.0～7.0秒】

女性从两只幻兽之间走出向前。

摄影机从稍低位置以正面斜角捕捉女性。

左右为巨大的蓝与紫幻兽。

女性从中央深处堂堂正正走来，通过两只之间。

女性不将视线从敌人身上移开。

头发与服装随风飘动，沉稳的步伐中让人感到强烈意志。

女性走到两只前方，就这样站在最前。

不是被保护的人物，而是作为率领幻兽战斗的指挥者来描绘。

■镜头12【7.0～7.9秒】

从斜下仰视蓝色幻兽的特写。

以蓝黑到群青为基础的巨大狮龙型幻兽。

厚重的獠牙、角、长鬃毛、巨大前脚、发蓝光的眼。

低声咆哮，朝敌人向前踏出一步前脚。

鬃毛因敌人方向的风剧烈摇动。

■镜头13【7.9～8.6秒】

从斜下仰视紫色幻兽的特写。

以黑紫到蓝紫为基础的鸟兽·爬虫类型幻兽。

长颈、锐利下颚、翼或背部大突起、发紫光的眼。

展开翼端与背部突起，朝敌人压低身体。

紫色轮廓光使锐利轮廓浮现。

■镜头14【8.6～10.0秒】

最后的行走广角镜头。

从接近横向的斜位置拍摄的壮丽广角镜头。

从画面左近前向右深处延伸、具有强烈纵深感的构图。

女性站在三者最前，稍后方左右跟着蓝色幻兽与紫色幻兽。

女性与两只幻兽朝存在于画面右深处的敌人缓慢迈步。

女性保持较低重心堂堂前进，手臂为可转入战斗的自然架势。

蓝色幻兽以沉重步伐踏地。

紫色幻兽以锐利姿态配合女性步调。

展现三者朝同一敌人前进的强烈团结与共斗感。

摄影机保持接近横向的斜位置，与三者平行缓慢横移。

同时极轻微推近。

持续运动女性的行走、幻兽的沉重脚步、头发、鬃毛、翼端、尾巴、雾、魔力粒子。

在前进方向的黑暗中，空气因敌人的压力而扭曲，蓝紫色的光不规则明灭。

最后，保持从接近横向的斜角捕捉站在最前的女性与其背后左右护卫的两只巨大幻兽，以战斗开始前强有力的团队镜头收尾。

【摄影演出】

序盘以眼部、指尖、侧脸等短特写提升紧张感。

魔法阵的启动以斜侧、仰拍、越过魔法阵的主观风镜头立体呈现。

召唤途中使用幽体一部分缓慢浮现的诡异动作，以及之后实体化的速度差。

幻兽着地时使用贴地低角度与有限的摄影机震动。

不只以说明性的固定画角展示幻兽全身，要夹入獠牙、眼、前脚、翼、鬃毛等短近景。

最终镜头较长时间保持接近横向的斜角广角镜头。

不使用无意义的360度旋转、过度手抖、过于频繁的变焦、相同画角的重复。
extra-8ac908282499.en:
[Video Specifications]
10 seconds, 16:9, widescreen full screen.

A theatrical dark fantasy anime on a total production budget scale of 1 billion yen.
No music, sound effects only.
No subtitles, no text, no logos.

High-quality Japanese dark fantasy anime. Based on 2D cel animation, with high-density digital compositing used only for magic effects, luminescence, particles, and spectral/spirit-body expressions.

Based on a dark space, with a limited color palette centered on blue, azure, cyan, pale blue-white, ultramarine, purple, and black.

Strong luminescence, hard shadows, blue and purple rim light, fine magic particles drifting in the air, thin mist, atmospheric perspective.

[Character]

Faithfully reproduce the female character in the reference image attached at generation time.

Maintain the face, hairstyle, hair color, costume, physique, and apparent age consistently across all cuts.

The woman has a calm expression with suppressed emotion, but her eyes hold a clear will and tension to stand against the enemy.

She always fixes her gaze on the enemy that exists ahead.

Even while controlling magic, she does not keep looking only at the magic circles, but directs her gaze toward the enemy beyond them.

In all cuts, the fingers of both hands have a normal five fingers. Do not break the fingers, arms, face, or human anatomy.

[How the enemy is shown]

The powerful enemy they face exists toward the back right of the screen or ahead in the direction of travel.

Do not clearly show the enemy's full body or true identity.

Express the existence of a gigantic enemy through her gaze, the strong wind blowing from the enemy's side, slight tremors in the ground, distortion of the air, the phenomenon of mist and particles being pushed back, low shockwaves, and an ominous backlight shining in from the depths of the darkness.

The woman and the two phantom beasts all fix their gaze on the enemy in the same direction.

Rather than waiting in place after summoning, clearly depict the flow in which the woman and the two phantom beasts together attempt to advance against the enemy.

[Important specification for the magic circles]

The magic expression used is circular magic circles only.

The number of magic circles must be exactly two. Do not increase to three or more.

The two magic circles must always be placed in front of the woman in every cut.

Do not make them appear above her head, directly behind her, or in positions surrounding the woman.

Place a blue magic circle on the front left side of the woman, and a purple magic circle on the front right side.

Each activates as an independent summoning formula.

The magic circles are semi-transparent ring-shaped or thin disc-shaped.

Composed of ancient characters, geometric patterns, multiple concentric circles, crests, and rotating rings.

Not a mechanical UI, but an impression of a mysterious and solemn ancient summoning ritual.

The blue magic circle emits blue, cyan, and pale blue-white light.

The purple magic circle emits purple, blue-purple, and light purple light.

[Important specification for the summoning direction]

Do not make the phantom beasts suddenly appear as complete full bodies from the start.

From the two magic circles, first make only parts of the phantom beasts' bodies—such as hands, forelegs, feet, claws—appear in a spectral/spirit-body state.

The spectral parts are semi-transparent, with blue or purple light flowing inside.

Do not make them burst out of the magic circles vigorously.

Like a gigantic presence surfacing from beneath the water's surface, quietly, heavily, eerily, gradually float forward.

Even within a short cut, make it look like a moment of slow movement is captured, not a fast charge.

The motion of the spectral parts appearing continues into the next materialization cut, connecting smoothly across cuts to the full-body materialization.

From the blue magic circle, summon one blue-type phantom beast.

From the purple magic circle, summon one purple-type phantom beast.

There must be exactly two phantom beasts.

The two are summoned to the front left and right of the woman.

Immediately after summoning, the two phantom beasts stand in front of the woman.

After that, from between the two phantom beasts, the woman walks out proudly forward and stands at the head of the three.

Depict the woman not as being protected and hiding behind them, but as a commander who herself stands against the enemy.

[Phantom beast design]

Only two phantom beasts. They have clearly different silhouettes from each other.

The first is a blue-type gigantic phantom beast summoned from the blue magic circle.

A heavyweight phantom beast fusing lion and dragon, with blue-black, ultramarine, and cyan as base colors.

Has sharp fangs, thick horns, a long mane, huge forelegs, and blue glowing eyes.

A weighty quadrupedal type. Dust flies every time it stamps the ground.

The second is a purple-type gigantic phantom beast summoned from the purple magic circle.

A phantom beast fusing bird-beast and reptile, with black-purple, blue-purple, and light purple as base colors.

Has a long neck, sharp jaws or beak, wings or large back protrusions, and purple glowing eyes.

Make its silhouette more slender and sharp than the blue phantom beast, visually distinguishing the two.

Both are overwhelmingly larger than the woman.

Do not let them stand still like ornaments; subtly move their breathing, manes, wingtips, tails, ears, claws, and glowing eyes.

Both are under the woman's control and take a battle-ready stance toward the common enemy.

[Direction policy]

Use many cuts within 10 seconds.

Do not use the same angle consecutively.

Switch between close-ups of the eyes, extreme close-ups of fingertips, diagonal side views, low-angle shots, subjective-style shots through the magic circles, ultra-low angles just above the ground, diagonal rear views, and near-horizontal diagonal wide shots.

The first half shows the tension of fixing the gaze on the enemy and the precision of magic manipulation.

The middle shows the eeriness of spectral parts floating out and the impact of the gigantic phantom beasts materializing.

The latter half shows the initiative of the woman stepping forward from between the two, and the sense of fighting together as the three face the enemy.

Maintain some kind of motion in every cut: hair, costume, light, particles, mist, magic circles, the breathing of the phantom beasts, etc.

[Cut structure from 0.0 to 10.0 seconds]

■Cut 1 [0.0–0.5 sec]

An extreme close-up capturing the woman's eyes.

The woman sharply fixes her gaze on the enemy toward the back right of the screen.

Blue and purple reflected light appears in her eyes.

The strong wind blowing from the enemy's side sways her bangs, and the air trembles slightly.

A short, tense introduction.

■Cut 2 [0.5–1.0 sec]

An extreme close-up capturing the woman's hand.

Blue and purple light gather separately at her hand.

In the air in front of the woman, a small blue ring and a purple ring begin to appear.

Circular patterns expand like ripples from her hand.

The background is darkened and blurred with a shallow depth of field.

■Cut 3 [1.0–1.6 sec]

A medium close-up from a diagonal side angle.

A blue magic circle forms on the front left side of the woman, and a purple magic circle on the front right side.

The two magic circles are in front of her, and the darkness on the enemy's side is visible through the magic circles.

The woman fixes her gaze not only on the magic circles but on the enemy beyond them.

Her hair and costume billow greatly in the headwind from the enemy's side.

■Cut 4 [1.6–2.2 sec]

A low-angle medium shot looking up at the woman.

The woman manipulates both hands, and the magic circles at the front left and right increase their rotation speed.

The blue magic circle and the purple magic circle pulse independently.

Ancient characters, concentric circles, and crests glow strongly.

■Cut 5 [2.2–2.8 sec]

A subjective-style shot through the magic circles.

A gigantic circular pattern and rotating ancient characters in the foreground.

Briefly show the blue magic circle and the purple magic circle in front of her alternately.

While moving her hands, the woman's gaze is fixed on the enemy beyond the magic circles.

■Cut 6 [2.8–3.0 sec]

A spectral/spirit-body cut during summoning.

From the blue magic circle, the tip of the blue-type phantom beast's gigantic foreleg and hooked claws begin to slowly float out as a semi-transparent spirit body.

From the purple magic circle, the purple-type phantom beast's gigantic hand, foot, or sharp claws begin to quietly emerge as a semi-transparent spirit body.

Do not make them burst out vigorously.

Within the short duration, capture only a moment of the slow appearing motion.

Blue or purple light slowly flows inside the spirit bodies.

This motion continues into the next cut.

■Cut 7 [3.0–3.7 sec]

An ultra-low angle looking up from near the ground.

The spectral forelegs and claws that had been floating out from the magic circles in front of her materialize while slowly emerging forward as they are.

They change from semi-transparent spirit bodies into heavy material bodies with fur, scales, horns, and claws.

Subsequently, the heads, torsos, wings, and tails pass through the magic circles, and the two gigantic phantom beasts fully reveal themselves.

The blue phantom beast has a pale blue-white luminescence.

The purple phantom beast has a purple luminescence.

At the same moment materialization completes, the light intensity rises sharply.

■Cut 8 [3.7–4.3 sec]

An ultra-low angle just above the ground.

The gigantic forelegs of the blue phantom beast and the purple phantom beast land on the ground with a time lag.

The impact of the landing shakes the ground, and dust and small stones bounce up.

A blue shockwave and a purple shockwave run separately across the floor surface.

Immediately after landing, the two turn their heads toward the enemy.

■Cut 9 [4.3–5.0 sec]

Fragmented close-ups using a fast whip pan.

The blue phantom beast's fangs, horns, mane, and blue glowing eyes.

The purple phantom beast's sharp jaws, wingtips, back protrusions, and purple glowing eyes.
